The giraffe exhibits a material fusion artifact where the wood-grain neck meets the glittery body without a plausible joint or transition. The guitars suffer from missing string details—a common AI generation flaw where strings merge into the fretboard or soundhole. Koala anatomy is heavily stylized (mitten-like paws, no claws, simplified ears), failing biological taxonomy checkpoints for fur texture, nose leatheriness, and digit structure. While aesthetically coherent as toy figurines, these deviations represent authentic generation artifacts when evaluated against real-world object standards.
